messages:
Eli: Opening PR to add a focused 'private installer: offline mirror + HSM load-shedding' section. Includes tiny systemd example for cert sync, mirror checksum workflow, and guidance for HSM backoff + minimal nftables/iptables fallbacks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4811
Cam: Nice. Please include explicit note to limit SSH (22) to the maintenance bastion and call out PKCS#11 port 5696 in the port matrix. Also mention UDP 123 for NTP.
Sana: Security suggestions: add chmod 660 on PKCS#11 sockets, add a one-liner to disable core dumps for the redwood user, and recommend mounting /var/run with private tmp for the HSM process on SELinux hosts. Wording: "Ensure PKCS#11 sockets are owned by redwood:pkcs11 with 660 perms and protected by proper SELinux context where applicable."
Riley: Draft systemd unit + timer for cert sync (will tidy in the PR):
```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-cert-sync.service
[Unit]
Description=Import offline cert bundle
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-sync-certs.sh /tmp/certs.tgz

# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-cert-sync.timer
[Unit]
Description=Run cert sync weekly
[Timer]
OnCalendar=weekly
```
Riley: And minimal sync script sketch: `scp bastion:/tmp/certs.tgz /tmp/ && sha256sum -c /tmp/certs.tgz.sha256 && tar -xzf /tmp/certs.tgz -C /etc/redwood/certs && chown -R redwood:redwood /etc/redwood/certs`
Eli: For HSM guidance add a short paragraph: exponential backoff with jitter on PKCS#11 connect + graceful fallback to a read-only cache for cert operations during HSM maintenance. Example backoff pseudo: sleep base*2^n + jitter. Also add note not to open tight polling loops at install time.
Cam: Firewall examples: one minimal nftables table and an iptables fallback snippet. Keep them tiny (accept loopback + 443 + 5696, drop rest). Also add conntrack sysctl tune: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` for busy installs.
Docs-Bot: docs-preview: build OK for PR #4811  preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/4811/ :white_check_mark:
Sana: Two doc UX items: add a small TOC anchors block at the top (Ports / Firewall / Offline mirror / HSM) and fix the broken link in the install checklist (change #network-check -> #networking-check). I'll push wording edits.
Eli: Thanks all  I'll merge after the quick edits and then add a link from the migration index. Everyone good to review? :eyes:
Cam: Reviewing now, minor wording nits coming.
Riley: Pushed the timer + unit in a follow-up commit.
